stories.title: Scaffolding + Shell
stories.description: Initialize Vite + React + TypeScript project with React Router, Cohere design system CSS variables, and sidebar navigation layout.
acceptanceCriteria: Vite project initializes and builds successfully
TypeScript configured with strict mode
React Router set up with browser routing
Home page loads at / with white canvas background
Sidebar navigation renders with topic links
Cohere CSS variables defined for colors, spacing, radius, typography
E2E: Playwright navigates to / and finds sidebar with topic links

stories.title: Core Architecture + Section Registry
stories.description: Build hexagonal core: section registry pattern, useAnimation hook for anime.js control, and routes.ts for lazy-loaded topic pages.
acceptanceCriteria: SectionRegistry supports register/get/list operations
useAnimation hook creates anime.js timeline and returns control functions
routes.ts exports typed route configuration array
TopicShell component renders topic from route config with lazy loading
Section wrapper reads config and renders registered section type
Unit tests pass for registry, hook, and route config

stories.title: Overview Page
stories.description: Topic overview page with Shadcn UI table with search, filter, pagination, and sort.
acceptanceCriteria: Overview page at / shows table of topics from routes.ts
Search input filters topics by title and description
Filter chips narrow by category/tag
Pagination shows configurable rows per page
Column headers are clickable for sort (asc/desc)
Clicking topic navigates to topic page
E2E: Playwright loads overview, searches, filters, and clicks topic link

stories.title: ArchitectureFlow Section
stories.description: Reusable SVG architecture diagram section with anime.js node/edge animations.
acceptanceCriteria: Section renders SVG diagram from config
Nodes appear in configured sequence on animation play
Edges draw with stroke animation
Play/pause/step controls work correctly
Section registers with SectionRegistry
E2E: Playwright verifies SVG renders and animation controls respond

stories.title: DataFlow Section
stories.description: Reusable section with animated particles flowing along SVG paths.
acceptanceCriteria: Section renders SVG paths and particle animations
Particles move along configured paths
Step mode highlights one flow at a time
Play/pause/step controls work correctly
Section registers with SectionRegistry
E2E: Playwright verifies animation renders and controls respond

stories.title: StepByStep Section
stories.description: Progressive reveal section with next/prev controls and step animation.
acceptanceCriteria: Section renders current step content
Next/Prev buttons advance/retreat steps
Progress indicator shows current position
Content animates in per step (fade/slide)
First/last step disable Prev/Next appropriately
Section registers with SectionRegistry
E2E: Playwright clicks Next/Prev and verifies step content changes

stories.title: DragDrop Section
stories.description: Interactive drag-and-drop exercise section with validation feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: Items are draggable with cursor feedback
Drop zones highlight on drag hover
Items snap to drop zones on release
Validation shows correct/incorrect feedback colors
Reset button returns items to original positions
Section registers with SectionRegistry
E2E: Playwright drags item to zone and validates feedback

stories.title: Choice Section
stories.description: Design choice comparison section with pros/cons and selection state.
acceptanceCriteria: Options render as selectable cards
Click toggles selection (single mode: only one selected)
Pros/cons display with icons
Selected option shows expanded details
Selection state persists during topic session
Section registers with SectionRegistry
E2E: Playwright clicks options and verifies selection state

stories.title: Text Section
stories.description: Simple prose section with headings, paragraphs, inline code, and links.
acceptanceCriteria: Section renders prose content with proper typography
Headings follow Cohere scale
Inline code renders with monospace styling
Links styled with action-blue and underline
Optional entrance animation works
Section registers with SectionRegistry
Unit tests pass for content rendering

stories.title: Bullets Section
stories.description: Bullet and numbered list section with nesting, checkable items, and stagger animation.
acceptanceCriteria: Unordered list renders with custom bullet markers
Ordered list renders with numbered items
Nested lists indent correctly
Checkable items toggle checked state
Stagger animation reveals items sequentially
Section registers with SectionRegistry
Unit tests pass for list rendering

stories.title: [TEST] Demo - Topic Shell & Routing
stories.description: Integration test harness: demo topic scaffold and routing used to test individual section stories (US-4..US-10).
acceptanceCriteria: Route available at /demo/rest-vs-websocket
Topic component lazy-loads with Suspense boundary
Topic scaffold reserves space for all demo sections in order
Unit test for route and lazy loading exists

stories.title: [TEST] Demo - ArchitectureFlow Integration
stories.description: Test case for ArchitectureFlow (US-4) showing REST vs WebSocket diagrams and controls.
acceptanceCriteria: ArchitectureFlow renders demo SVGs for REST and WebSocket variants
Play/pause/step controls affect the demo animation sequence
Data-testid present for SVG container and controls
E2E: Playwright verifies ArchitectureFlow renders and controls respond

stories.title: [TEST] Demo - Data & Narrative Sections
stories.description: Test case for DataFlow (US-5), StepByStep (US-6), Text (US-9), and Bullets (US-10) with demo content.
acceptanceCriteria: DataFlow shows particles along demo paths
StepByStep contains the REST lifecycle steps with next/prev
Text and Bullets sections display narrative content
Sections register with SectionRegistry and render in the demo topic

stories.title: [TEST] Demo - Interactive Exercises
stories.description: Test case for DragDrop (US-7) and Choice (US-8) exercises used by the demo topic.
acceptanceCriteria: DragDrop exercise validates scenario categorization
Choice section shows pros/cons and persists selection during session
Interactive sections expose deterministic test ids for E2E
E2E: Playwright interacts with exercises and asserts expected outcomes

stories.title: [TEST] Demo - Full E2E Walkthrough
stories.description: End-to-end test that verifies all demo sections exercise happy paths of US-4..US-10.
acceptanceCriteria: Playwright test navigates to demo topic and verifies each demo section in order
Selectors use data-testid attributes for deterministic selection
Test runs against dev server with webServer configured or manual `npm run dev` started

stories.title: Demo Topic - REST API vs WebSocket (Orchestration)
stories.description: Orchestrate the demo topic which composes the individual sections. Coordinates all demo sub-stories.
acceptanceCriteria: Topic page loads at /demo/rest-vs-websocket
Topic composes the required demo section stories in order
Overview page includes the demo topic entry
E2E: Playwright can navigate to the demo topic page
